correctness.rationale: A two-color rainbow path has at most two edges. Every nonadjacent pair is cross-layer and has two possible length-two paths. For a pair of indices the two simultaneous Boolean constraints forbid (red,red) when both rungs red, forbid (blue,blue) when both blue, and require equal layer-edge colors when rung colors differ. Each unordered index pair uses disjoint variables, proving exact product factors z(2+z),1+2z and 1+z². Minimizing over t=n-b gives n-1+(t-1)(t-2)/2 and exactly n+2*binom(n,2)=n² minimizers. Independent direct path enumeration over all 2^(n²) assignments for n=2,3,4 produced 10,126,4050 valid colorings, support and reciprocity; the local combinatorial proof handles every n>=2.
residual_risks: Enumeration does not cover larger n; exact n>=2 proof comes from disjoint-pair factorization.
